blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen
vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and
image–text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate
whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader
way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts.
Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics,
relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference
distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing
a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model
while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple
public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range
of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks.
The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings
and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen
during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the
response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated
embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature
groups provide complementary information and that the method remains
effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine
inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks.
Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic
prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image
detection in frozen VLMs.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a central component of modern AI systems [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Models such as CLIP [ 1 ] align images and natural-language descriptions in a shared representation space, enabling zero-shot recognition, multimodal retrieval, and open-vocabulary reasoning without task-specific retraining. These capabilities make VLM representations attractive for downstream systems that must interpret visual inputs through flexible semantic concepts. Their growing use in applications such as content moderation and autonomous systems [ 4 ] also makes the reliability of these representations increasingly important.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)已成为现代AI系统[1,2,3]的核心组成部分. CLIP [1]等模型将图像和自然语言描述在一个共享的表示空间中相接,使得零发识别,多模式回取,以及开放-vobulary推理没有针对任务的再培训. 这些能力使得VLM表示对下游系统具有吸引力,这些系统必须通过灵活的语义概念来解释视觉输入. 它们越来越多地用于内容节制和自主系统等应用[4]也使得这些表述的可靠性越来越重要.

blocks.en: Despite their strong generalization capabilities, VLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. As with conventional vision models, small input perturbations can change the model prediction while leaving the image visually similar to the original [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Detecting such inputs is challenging because an adversarial example does not necessarily produce an obviously abnormal final confidence score. A successful perturbation may still yield a confident zero-shot prediction or apparently plausible image–text similarities. Consequently, examining only the final classifier output can discard information contained in the broader representation produced by the VLM.
blocks.zh: 尽管具有强大的通俗化能力,VLM仍然容易受到对抗性的干扰. 和常规视觉模型一样,小输入扰动可以改变模型预测,同时将图像留作视觉上与原作相类似 [5, 6, 7, 8]. 检测这种投入具有挑战性,因为对抗性的例子不一定产生明显不正常的最终信心分数。 成功扰动仍有可能产生自信的零射出预测,或明显可信的图像-文字相似性。 因此,只有审查最后的分类器产出,才能丢弃由VLM产生的更广泛的表述中所包含的信息.

blocks.en: Existing adversarial detectors exploit several forms of representation abnormality. Confidence-based approaches use quantities such as maximum softmax probability or energy scores [ 9 , 10 ] . Other methods measure sensitivity to input transformations, density in feature space, local intrinsic dimensionality, Mahalanobis distance, or related representation statistics [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . More recent VLM-specific methods analyze geometric properties of pretrained multimodal embeddings, attention responses, or learned semantic priors [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . These approaches demonstrate that adversarial perturbations can leave detectable signatures beyond the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 现有的对抗探测器利用了几种形式的代表异常. 基于信任的方法使用数量,如最大软度概率或能量分数[9,10]. 其他方法测量对输入转换的敏感性,特征空间的密度,局部内在维度,马哈拉诺比斯相距,或相关的表示统计[11,12,13]. 较近期的VLM特有方法分析预受训练多式嵌入的几何特性,注意响应,或已学会的语义前传[14,15,16,17]. 这些方法表明,对抗性的扰动可能会使可探测的签名超出最终预测.

blocks.en: Our motivation is that a frozen VLM provides another source of information that is naturally available but not fully represented by a single confidence score or embedding-space distance: its pattern of responses across many text prompts. Given an image and a collection of text prompts, a CLIP-style model produces a vector of image–text similarities rather than a single scalar output. This vector describes how the image is positioned relative to multiple directions in the joint vision–language space. Adversarial perturbations that alter the image representation can therefore change not only the predicted dataset class, but also the distribution, local relationships, reference deviations, and transformation behavior of these prompt-conditioned responses.
blocks.zh: 我们的动机是,被冻结的VLM提供了另一个信息来源,这种信息来源自然是可以得到的,但并非完全以单一的置信分数或嵌入-空间距离为代表:它在许多文本提示中的反应模式。 考虑到图像和文本提示的集合,一个CLIP风格的模型会产生图像的矢量-文本相似性,而不是单一的scalar输出. 此向量描述图像相对于多方向在联合视觉-语言空间中的位置. 因此,改变图像表现的负面扰动不仅可以改变所预测的数据集类,还可以改变这些快速条件反应的分布,局部关系,参考偏差和变换行为.

blocks.en: This observation motivates treating adversarial detection as a response-profiling problem. Instead of asking only whether the input has low confidence or lies far from clean samples in the image embedding space, we characterize how the input interacts with a fixed semantic reference space. We use general prompts that are separate from the dataset class prompts used by the zero-shot classifier. Their image–text similarities provide a reusable representation from which we can extract several complementary measurements.
blocks.zh: 这一观察促使人们将对抗性检测视为一个反应-显示问题。 我们不只询问输入在图像嵌入空间中是否具有低信心或远离清洁样本,而是描述输入与固定语义参考空间的相互作用. 我们使用与零发分级器使用的数据集类分级提示相分离的普通提示. 它们的图像-文本相似性提供了一个可重复使用的说明,我们可以从中提取一些互补的测量。

blocks.en: The novelty of our approach lies in constructing a compact detector representation from multiple properties of this prompt-conditioned response. First, category-level statistics summarize how similarity mass is distributed across broad semantic groups. Second, we use a graph built from text-embedding relationships to measure global and local variation among prompt responses. Third, clean-reference residuals quantify how the observed response differs from response distributions estimated from clean training images. Fourth, graph diffusion measures how the response changes under smoothing over related prompts. Finally, weak transformations of the input provide stability measurements that characterize how the VLM response changes under small image modifications. These components are concatenated into a compact response profile and classified by a lightweight multilayer perceptron.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的新颖之处在于从这种迅速反应的多种特性中构建出一种紧凑的探测器。 首先,类别级统计总结了相似性质量在广义语义组的分布. 第二,我们利用由文本混合关系所制作的图表来衡量全球和地方在迅速反应中的差异。 第三,清洁参考后遗症量化观察到的反应与清洁训练图像估计的反应分布有何不同。 第四,图表传播衡量反应在平滑处理下如何变化。 最后,输入的微弱变换提供了稳定性测量,其特征是VLM响应在小图像修改下是如何变化的. 这些组件被收缩成一个紧凑的反应剖面并被轻量级多层受体所分类.

blocks.en: This design differs from existing VLM-based adversarial detectors in both the representation analyzed and how the pretrained model is used. Geometry-based methods such as GeoDetect operate primarily on distances or density-related properties of pretrained embeddings [ 15 ] , while prompt-based irrelevant probing (PIP) uses attention responses generated by irrelevant probing questions [ 16 ] . Our method instead operates directly on the pattern of image–text similarities generated by a fixed prompt bank and combines several summaries of that response into a single detector representation. The underlying image encoder, text encoder, prompt embeddings, and prompt graph remain frozen; only the small detector operating on the extracted features is trained.
blocks.zh: 这种设计与现有的基于VLM的对抗性探测器在所分析的表示和如何使用预先训练过的模型上有所不同. 以几何学为基础的方法,如地探测法,主要在预先被训练的嵌入物的相距或密度相关属性上运作 [15],而即时不相干地探测(PIP)则使用不相干地探测问题产生的注意响应 [16]. 我们的方法直接根据固定的快取库所产生的图像-文本相似性模式运作,并将该反应的几个摘要合并为一个探测器代表。 基础图像编码器,文本编码器,即时嵌入和即时图仍然被冻结;只有运行在被取出特性上的小探测器才被训练出.

blocks.en: An additional motivation for this design is interpretability at the feature-group level. Because the final detector operates on an explicitly constructed low-dimensional representation rather than a newly learned VLM representation, we can evaluate the contributions of different signal families separately. We can therefore remove or combine category, graph, residual, and transformation-stability components without modifying the frozen backbone. This lets us study the detector as a composition of measurable response properties rather than an opaque classifier operating directly on high-dimensional pretrained embeddings.
blocks.zh: 这种设计的另一个动机是在特征组层面的解释性. 因为最终的探测器在明确构造的低维代表上运行,而不是在新学到的VLM代表上运行,所以我们可以分别评价不同信号家族的贡献. 因此,我们可以删除或合并类别、图表、剩余和变换稳定性组件,而无需修改被冻结的骨干。 这让我们研究探测器,把它作为可测量的反应特性的成分,而不是直接在高维先受训练的嵌入上操作的不透明分类器.

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed detector across CIFAR-10, STL-10, and Tiny-ImageNet using ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, and ConvNeXt CLIP-style backbones. The evaluation covers PGD, MI-FGSM, CW, AutoAttack, and flow-based attacks under both standard attack-specific and cross-attack settings. We additionally evaluate a confidence-based MSP detector, compare against embedding-geometry detectors under a controlled protocol, measure the contribution of individual feature groups through controlled ablations, quantify inference cost, and study detector-aware attacks. Together, these experiments evaluate both the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed response representation and the contribution of its individual components.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Vit-B/16、Vit-B/32和ConvNEXt CLIP型主干网,对拟议的CIFAR-10、STL-10和Tiny-ImageNet的探测器进行评估。 评价范围包括PGD,MI-FGSM,CW,AutoAttack,以及标准攻击特有和交叉攻击设置下的以流为主的攻击. 我们还对基于信任的MSP探测器进行评估,与受控协议下的嵌入地对地测量探测器进行比较,通过受控分解测量单个特征组的贡献,量化推断成本并研究探测器-感知攻击。 这些实验共同评价了拟议反应表述的有效性和概括性及其各个组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce adversarial image detection through prompt-conditioned response profiling , using the pattern of image–text similarities produced by a frozen VLM as the basis for detection. • We develop a compact representation that combines category-level statistics, prompt-graph measurements, clean-reference residuals, graph-diffusion features, and transformation-stability features while keeping the underlying VLM fixed. • We use a lightweight MLP detector that operates only on the extracted response profile, enabling analysis of individual feature groups without fine-tuning the VLM backbone. • We provide a multi-dataset, multi-backbone, and multi-attack evaluation including standard and cross-attack detection, a confidence baseline, controlled comparisons with embedding-geometry detectors, feature ablations, runtime measurements, and detector-aware evaluation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们通过快速、有条件的反应剖面来引入对抗性图像检测,使用由被冻结的VLM生成的图像-文本相似模式作为检测的基础。 我们发展了一种紧凑的表述方式,将分类统计、即时图测量、清洁参考后遗症、图分化特征和变相稳定性特征结合起来,同时使基本VLM保持不变。 我们使用一种轻量级的MLP探测器,该探测器只在所提取的响应剖面上运行,能够对单个特征组进行分析,而无需对VLM主干线进行微调。 我们提供了一个多数据集、多后骨和多攻击评价,包括标准和交叉攻击探测、信心基线、与嵌入地对地测量探测器的可控比较、特征分解、运行时间测量和探测器意识评价。

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: This section reviews three groups of related work: adversarial example detection, VLM methods for semantic detection, and adversarial detection methods designed for VLMs. This context positions our prompt-conditioned response-profiling approach relative to existing confidence-, geometry-, and VLM-based detectors.
blocks.zh: 本节回顾了三组相关工作:对抗性实例检测、语义检测的VLM方法和为VLM设计的对抗性检测方法。 相对于现有的置信、几何和以甚高分辨率探测器而言,这种背景定位了我们具有迅速条件的反应显示方法。

blocks.en: II-A Adversarial example detection
blocks.zh: II-A 横向实例检测

blocks.en: Adversarial example detection has been widely studied for image classifiers. Early methods use confidence-based scores, including maximum softmax probability (MSP) and energy-based scoring, to identify abnormal inputs [ 9 , 10 ] . Other approaches compare model behavior under input transformations, such as feature squeezing, or estimate sample density in deep feature spaces [ 11 , 18 ] . Representation-based methods detect adversarial inputs using feature statistics or geometry, including local intrinsic dimensionality (LID), Mahalanobis distance, and statistical tests [ 12 , 13 , 19 ] . Nearest-neighbor methods further show that local representation structure can provide useful detection signals [ 20 ] . These methods can often identify adversarial inputs by detecting abnormal model behavior, but they are primarily designed for unimodal classifiers.
blocks.zh: 对图像分类器进行了广泛的研究。 早期的方法使用基于信心的分数,包括最大软马克斯概率(MSP)和以能为基础的分数,以识别异常输入[9,10]. 其他方法比较输入转换下的模型行为,如特征挤压,或估算深地特征空间中的样本密度[11,18]. 以代表为基础的方法利用地物统计或几何来检测对抗性的投入,包括当地固有的维度(LID)、Mahalanobis距离和统计测试[12、13、19]。 近邻方法进一步表明,当地代表结构可以提供有用的检测信号[20]. 这些方法往往可以通过检测异常模型行为来识别对抗性输入,但它们主要是为单模式分类器设计的.

blocks.en: II-B VLMs for out-of-distribution and semantic detection
blocks.zh: II-B 用于分配外和语义检测的VLM

blocks.en: VLMs provide semantic image-text representations that are useful for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. CLIP aligns images and text in a shared embedding space [ 1 ] . Building on this, maximum concept matching (MCM) uses image-text similarity scores for OOD detection [ 21 ] . CLIPN introduces negation-aware prompts for zero-shot OOD rejection [ 22 ] . Negative-label methods use auxiliary labels that describe concepts absent from the input or outside the target label set to improve semantic separation [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , while SimLabel uses consistency across related labels [ 26 ] . Recent work further analyzes the mechanisms and sensitivities of VLM-based OOD detection [ 27 ] , and surveys summarize progress with CLIP-like models [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: VLMs提供语义成像-文字表示,对分出(OO)检测有用. CLIP在共享嵌入空间中将图像和文本对齐 [1]. 在此基础上,最大概念匹配(MCM)使用图像-文本相似分来进行OOD检测[21]. CLIPN引入否定感-0发OD拒绝提示 [22]. 负标签方法使用辅助标签来描述输入或目标标签集外缺失的概念来改进语义分离[23,24,25],而SimLabel则使用相通相关标签的一致性[26]. 最近的工作进一步分析了基于VLM的OOD检测的机制和敏感性[27],调查总结了类似CLIP模型的进展[28].

blocks.en: These works show the value of semantic alignment for detecting distribution shifts. However, they mainly address OOD detection (not adversarial detection) and usually rely on class-specific prompts or aggregated image-text similarities.
blocks.zh: 这些作品展现出语义相配合对检测分布相变的价值. 然而,它们主要针对OOD检测(不是对抗检测),通常依赖于特定类的提示或集成图像-文本的相似性.

blocks.en: II-C Adversarial detection with VLMs
blocks.zh: II-C 具有VLMs的横向检测

blocks.en: Recent work has studied adversarial detection directly in vision-language settings. GAD-VLP applies geometric measures to representations extracted from unimodal or multimodal vision-language pre-trained model (VLP) encoders [ 14 ] . These measures include LID, k-NN distance, Mahalanobis distance, and kernel density estimation (KDE). GeoDetect studies similar geometric signals and connects adversarial detection to off-manifold behavior in anisotropic VLP embedding spaces [ 15 ] . PIP detects adversarial examples in large vision-language models (LVLMs) using attention patterns induced by irrelevant probe questions [ 16 ] . Another recent method uses CLIP text embeddings as semantic priors to guide learned latent representations for adversarial detection [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作是在视觉语言环境中直接研究对抗检测。 GAD-VLP对从单式或多式视觉语言预试模型(VLP)编码器中提取的表示法应用了几何测量. [14]. 这些措施包括LID、k-NN距离、Mahalanobis距离和内核密度估计(KDE)。 Geo Detect研究类似的几何信号,并将对抗性探测与异相VLP嵌入空间中的外向行为相接 [15]. PIP在大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)中检测到对抗性实例,使用不相干探测问题所诱发的注意模式[16]. 另一种近代方法使用CLIP文本嵌入为语义前缀来指导所学到的潜在表达,用于对抗性的检测 [17].

blocks.en: These methods show that VLMs provide useful signals for adversarial detection. They mainly focus on embedding geometry, attention maps, or learned latent spaces. In contrast, our method analyzes image-text similarity patterns from semantic prompts that are not tied to dataset labels. It models prompt relationships with a graph and extracts category, residual, and stability features from a frozen VLM.
blocks.zh: 这些方法表明VLM为对抗性的检测提供了有用的信号. 它们主要侧重于嵌入几何,注意力图,或所学到的潜在空间. 相形之下,我们的方法从语义提示中分析图像-文本的相似性模式,这些提示没有绑入数据集标签. 它的模型与一个图表建立快速关系,并从被冻结的VLM中提取分类,剩余和稳定性特征.

blocks.en: II-D Relationship to prior VLM-based detectors
blocks.zh: II-D 与以往基于VLM的探测器的关系

blocks.en: GAD-VLP and GeoDetect detect adversarial inputs from geometric deviations in VLP embedding spaces, using signals such as k-nearest-neighbor distance, Mahalanobis distance, KDE, and LID [ 14 , 15 ] . PIP instead probes large VLMs with irrelevant questions and classifies attention-derived responses [ 16 ] . Other approaches use CLIP text embeddings as semantic priors for learned adversarial detectors [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: GAD-VLP和地探测器探测出从VLP嵌入空间中几何偏差的对抗性输入,使用K-近邻距离、Mahalanobis距离、KDE和LID[14,15]等信号. 相反,PIP以无关问题对大型VLM进行探测,并对引起注意的响应进行分类[16]. 其他方法将CLIP文本嵌入作为已学会的对抗性探测器的语义前缀[17].

blocks.en: Our method differs in the representation supplied to the detector. It operates on prompt-conditioned image–text responses and combines category-level statistics, prompt-graph measurements, clean-reference residuals, graph diffusion, and transformation stability. The VLM itself remains frozen, and only the lightweight detector is trained.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法不同 向探测器提供的表示。 它基于快速的图像-文本响应,并结合了类别级统计、即时图测量、清洁参考残基、图表传播和变相稳定性。 VLM本身仍然被冷冻,只有轻量级探测器经过了训练.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: This section outlines the proposed framework. First, we formally define the problem setup and specify the threat model. Subsequently, we establish the semantic anchor space, followed by the graph-structured semantic representation, semantic residual modeling, and semantic stability under small transformations. Finally, we provide a technical description of the final detector.

blocks.en: Clean residual statistics are estimated only from clean training samples. For each semantic category, we compute the clean mean vector and covariance matrix of the corresponding prompt-similarity subvector. blocks.en: We use lightweight transformations to measure semantic stability. These include small spatial shifts, mild blur, and minor photometric changes such as contrast adjustment. blocks.en: The standard attack-specific evaluation consisted of 45 45 model-dataset-attack configurations, corresponding to 3 3 datasets, 3 3 VLM backbones, and 5 5 attacks. blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We presented a semantic-response profiling framework for adversarial image detection with frozen vision-language models. The detector summarizes image–text responses using category, graph, residual, diffusion, and transformation-stability features while leaving the VLM backbone fixed. Across multiple datasets, backbones, and attacks, the method achieves strong standard detection performance and strong cross-attack transfer. Controlled comparisons show that the proposed response-profile representation provides information beyond confidence-based and geometric embedding scores, while feature ablations demonstrate complementary contributions from the different feature groups, with transformation stability providing the largest individual improvement. Detector-aware evaluation further shows that the detector retains substantial discrimination under adaptive optimization. Overall, these results support semantic-response profiling as an effective complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个语义反应剖面框架,用于用冷冻的视觉语言模型进行对抗性图像检测。 探测器使用分类、图表、残余、扩散和变相稳定性等特性,同时将VLM主干线固定下来,对图像-文本反应进行总结。 通过多套数据集,骨干和攻击,该方法实现了强大的标准检测性能和强大的交叉攻击转移. 控制下的比较表明,拟议中的应急说明提供了超出基于信任和几何嵌入分数的信息,而特征分解则显示了不同特征组的互补贡献,转型稳定性提供了最大的个人改进。 探测器的认知评价进一步表明,探测器在适应性优化下保留了实质性的歧视. 总的来说,这些结果支持语义反应剖面分析,作为冷冻VLM中对抗图像检测的有效补充信号.
